questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm straight out to the side, it is a hand signal that means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or go straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that a curve is coming up on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles may regularly cross or travel alongside the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Then you may proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead. Be prepared for a sharp change in road grade.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic from the right will merge into your lane. Be ready to allow merging vehicles in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that bicycles may cross the road ahead. Watch for bike traffic and be ready to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road when conditions are perfect. If the weather is bad or the road is wet, you should drive slower than the posted limit for safety.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes very slippery when it rains or is wet. Drive slowly and carefully in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This circular sign marks a railroad crossing. Watch for trains and be prepared to stop if you see one approaching.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane you are in will leave the highway at the exit ramp. You must change lanes to stay on the highway, or you will exit. Choose your lane carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate roadways going in opposite directions, separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way directions with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs like this always mean no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic will merge onto the road from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: The shoulder ahead is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control. Instead, ease back onto the road carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show your intentions when turn signals are not working. A left arm extended straight out means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.
